name: Community Rivercare Program

funder.name: Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions (Western Australia)

summary: Recurring rounds of small grants for community volunteer groups doing on-ground waterway work in the Swan Canning catchment around Perth: foreshore revegetation, weed control, bank stabilisation and habitat improvement.

pool.quote: Through Round 10 a total of $100,000 is available to deliver on-ground projects during 2027-28.

applicant_types.quote: Grants of between $3,000 and $10,000 (ex GST) in total for the duration of the project will be provided to community volunteer groups

geography.quote: Projects must be in the Swan Canning Catchment or other catchments that feed into the Swan and Canning rivers.
